decisions.statement: A comment no program parses is prose whatever the comment says.
A form only another language parses represents nothing here.
A comment in code is read from the token stream rather than from the text.
A stylesheet has a comment in exactly one form.
A comment in a stylesheet is found by scanning past the strings the stylesheet has.
The forms are held in the check's own code.
A shebang is trivia the parser takes before any comment.

definition: the check refusing a comment that is none of the code comment forms
